environment.description: Same Lambda function deployed behind API Gateway with AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached. The WebACL includes a custom rule group with a byte-match condition inspecting the request body (first 8KB) for sequences containing '../' and '..\' patterns in application/zip and application/octet-stream content types, with a BLOCK action and priority 1. Additionally, an AWS managed rule group 'AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet' is associated with SizeRestriction_BODY rule overridden to BLOCK at 4KB threshold. The S3 bucket has a Lambda-layer-based antivirus scanner (ClamAV) that runs on PutObject events BEFORE the extraction Lambda is triggered, configured with YARA rules that flag ZIP entries containing path traversal sequences in their filename headers.

s3_antivirus_layer.yara_rules: rule zip_path_traversal { strings: $a = /../ $b = /..\\/ condition: any of them }
